Vendor launches Aurora 2

Aurora 2 is available today in the Vendor API for all paid accounts. The model supports a 500,000 token context window, up from 200,000 in Aurora 1.

Pricing for Aurora 2 is $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens. The previous generation remains available at its existing price.

Aurora 2 scored 74.5% on the SWE-bench Verified benchmark, according to Vendor's own evaluation. Vendor says tool-use reliability improved substantially over the prior release.

The model is available in the United States and the European Union at launch, with additional regions planned. A general availability date for other regions was not given.
